context: Tatsuya-country builds a small wooden shelf with Hiroshi-elder.
purpose: Two elders building together; shared craft labor.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: この木材、ええ感じやな。
lines.en: This wood has a good feel to it.
lines.style: Quiet appreciation in the opening. Warm, focused tone. Hand-moving-over-surface rhythm. Patient Tohoku drawl. Soft.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.style: Affirming nod in the voice. Gentle, approving inflection. Light tap of recognition. Soft Kansai cadence. Warm.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.style: Decisive but not rushed. Quiet focus settles in. Hands-forward energy. Tohoku directness underneath the gentleness. Steady.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: Carefully now — take our time with it.
lines.style: Patient instruction softly given. Gentle guidance, not hurrying. Kansai warmth on the second clause. Spacious breath. Encouraging.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.jp: お互い、年取っても、できる。
lines.en: Even at our age, we can still do this.
lines.style: Quiet pride underneath. Warm realization spreading across the line. Tohoku steadiness. Slight wonder — age hasn't taken this from us. Soft smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.en: Heh — really makes you happy, doesn't it?
lines.style: Small laugh opens it. Tender, genuine warmth. Kansai lilt on the final words. Soft gaze in the delivery. Fondness without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: tatsuya_country
lines.en: The shelf is done — looks fine.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction settles the moment. Pride without boasting. Tohoku contentment. Appreciative gaze at the work. Warm, complete.
